content: Patients have the right to seek a second opinion at any time and are encouraged to do so when facing significant clinical decisions such as surgery, long-term medication, or a serious diagnosis. To request a second opinion within the clinic, patients should contact the front desk or submit a request through the portal, specifying the specialist they wish to consult; when possible, the clinic will provide a doctor from the same specialty who was not involved in the original assessment. The clinic will compile and share all relevant medical records, test results, and imaging with the second-opinion doctor upon the patient's written consent. If the patient prefers to seek a second opinion outside the clinic, the treating doctor will prepare a comprehensive referral letter and provide copies of all relevant documentation. A second-opinion consultation is billed at the standard specialty consultation fee with no additional surcharge.
